The '''Three Sisters''' were the three [[Moon/Legends|moonlets]] of [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]], including [[Ruusan 2/Legends|Ruusan 2]]. The [[smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] of the planet, including [[Jerg]]'s crew, called them "The Triplets".<ref name="agent">''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]''</ref><ref name="jk">''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]''</ref>

Possibly one of them was settled in ancient times, as observers from Ruusan could observe some ruins.<ref name="jk" />

Typically they rose consecutively during the Ruusanian night, and each one rising gave more light to the nocturnal landscape.<ref name="agent" /><ref name="jk" />
